question: Общая выручка принятых заказов
sql: SELECT sum(total_kzt) AS revenue FROM orders

question: Число принятых заказов
sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders

question: Средний чек в тенге
sql: SELECT avg(total_kzt) AS average FROM orders

question: Доля задержек 0..1
sql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN actual_days>promised_days THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS delay_rate FROM orders

question: Выручка phone
sql: SELECT sum(total_kzt) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE channel='phone'

question: Общая header-выручка
sql: SELECT sum(o.total_kzt) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
